1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __200__ nanometers.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein the multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, and zirconium acetylacetonate.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __100 to 200__ nm in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine, seawater, and acidic conditions.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation selected from aluminum, iron, titanium, or zirconium.

18) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a zirconium ion crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein __the amounts of PEI and PVS are specifically adjusted to achieve a desired charge balance__. 

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid selected from the group consisting of water, field brine, or seawater. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __elevin-methyl acrylamide.__

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater, and said brine comprises sodium ions and chloride ions.
